shared_schema.input: Closed envelope: schema_version, synthetic=true, records (1..1000). Shared resource fields: id, resourceType, synthetic, version, impact, text.

entities.Patient: Synthetic diagnoses and labs; no direct patient identifiers.
entities.DocumentReference: Controlled clinical note text plus resolvable patientRef.
entities.Claim: Prior authorization with patientRef, use=preauthorization, status=pending|approved|denied.

shared_schema.output: Same resource fields plus analysis and incremented version; envelope includes status, review_queue, audit_trail, human_review_required and notice.
shared_schema.validation: One shared validator rejects unknown keys, identifiers, unsupported narrative vocabulary, invalid lab ranges/units, duplicate IDs and unresolved references. CLI rejects duplicate JSON keys and nonfinite numbers.
shared_schema.synthetic_identifiers: Local syn-kind-number references only; no real MRNs, names, dates of birth or external identifiers.

cross_stage_handoffs: Single integrated stage: validated resource -> transparent lexicon scoring -> severity-aware administrative review queue and audited annotations.

behavior.sentiment: Case-insensitive lexicon sum. Evidence includes term, base weight, negation and contribution. Negators reverse matches within the next three words, bounded by punctuation or but.
behavior.priority: Human-supplied impact base low=0, medium=10, high=20, critical=30 plus min(9,max(0,-sentiment)). Higher severity always dominates; ties sort by local resource ID.
behavior.safety: All records require human administrative review. No diagnosis, lab interpretation, clinical action or authorization approval is generated.
behavior.audit: Each annotation records actor, reason, deterministic sequence ID, record ID and before/after changes for analysis and version. Original input and clinical/workflow fields are unchanged.
behavior.deidentification: Reject rather than redact identifier-bearing fields or unsupported free text. Closed synthetic vocabulary deliberately restricts names, locations and dates. Demonstrative safeguards, not HIPAA certification.
behavior.errors: File, parsing and schema failures yield one non-echoing JSON error on stdout and exit 2.

included: FHIR-style resources, not full FHIR conformance

test_outcomes.cli: passed: example input printed one JSON object with status ok and exit 0
test_outcomes.error_cli: Verified missing argument, missing file, malformed JSON and invalid schema return JSON status error and exit 2.
